svg.title: Foundation plan and section A-A - isolated block for the HMC 500
svg.text: PLAN – isolated foundation block for one HMC 500 (scale 1:100 on A3, dimensions in mm)
Block 5 800 × 3 400 × 600 = 11.8 m³ = 28.4 t = 2.27 × machine (block calculator, ratio 2 → 0.529 m → min 0.60 m)
Block: C30/37, exposure XC3 + coating (coolant, oil);
max w/c 0.55; cover 50 (on blinding); 2 meshes Ø12 @ 150
top + bottom, extra U-bars at edges and around sleeves.
Ev2/Ev1 ≤ 2.3; blinding 50 C12/15; PE sheet 0.2 mm.
Sleeves: steel template from the maker's drawing, ±5 mm.
Top level: ±3 mm; flatness DIN 18202 table 3 line 4.
Curing ≥ 7 days wet; machine at ≥ 28 days or after
test cubes (engineer); grout only on clean, sound concrete.
All values = example – the structural engineer designs.
SECTION A–A (through the front pad row 1–2, scale 1:50 on A3)
machine bed (outline) – 12 000 kg + 510 kg pallet/work on 6 bolts
average 20.45 kN per bolt, highest (k = 1.5) 30.7 kN
levelling bolt M30×1.5 on steel pad Ø160×35
anchor sleeve Ø80×350 + M24, grouted after levelling
Foundation plan + section A–A – HMC 500 block
EXAMPLE – check the maker's installation manual
